description: Use this when a Phorme coach wants to hear how their AI coach answers one question, to check it sounds like them. It returns the answer and the coach's own passages it drew on, and changes nothing. Each answer runs Phorme's model under a spending cap; once the cap is reached it says so. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the brain.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

name: ask_my_coach
title: Ask my coach
